about_the_game: OpenFront is an exhilarating PvP battle-royale experience where players vie for global domination. Hundreds of competitors clash on a single, sprawling map, engaging in intense combat to expand their territories. Forge alliances through trade, amass wealth in gold, and unleash devastating nuclear strikes to obliterate your rivals. Strategy and supremacy reign in this unforgiving world—will you rise to conquer it all?
